recognize_zh: CD1a 染色整個視野皆無棕色陽性，中央竇內的大型組織球（淡藍圓核）與周圍淋巴球全為陰性；CD1a 陰性可排除蘭格罕細胞組織球增生症（LCH），支持 Rosai-Dorfman 病。
features: No CD1a staining in any cell population
Large sinus histiocytes with round vesicular nuclei are CD1a-negative
Hematoxylin counterstain only; pale sinus center flanked by dense lymphoid areas
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD1a is negative in the large sinus histiocytes as well as in the surrounding lymphocytes. The architecture shows an expanded pale sinus with large histiocytes bordered by dense lymphoid tissue. No internal positive control is present in this field, so staining validity depends on a separate control. This pertinent negative result argues against Langerhans cell histiocytosis and supports Rosai-Dorfman disease in combination with S100 positivity and emperipolesis.

ddx.vs: LCH cells show strong membranous CD1a and langerin positivity, with grooved nuclei and eosinophils.
Indeterminate cells are S100 and CD1a positive but langerin negative.
Reactive histiocytes are CD1a-negative like this image but also S100-negative, without emperipolesis.
